notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We are excited to announce that our game is a part of Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/acbfcdb9ad6540118cb53041410bc50decc2f9e8.png

This special event is organized to celebrate World Animal Day and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During Animal Week, our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/4660753243321301287

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/6407467d84d8cac0ff8bec4fca835c71f4296b0d.png

We are proud to support efforts to protect wildlife and their habitats by participating in this event. This initiative promises to provide an educational and entertaining experience for all players. 🤝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eb19fe493d76b11305b4420230767da78aeeadac.png

As part of our commitment, a portion of the revenue generated from our game during Animal Week will be donated to animal welfare organizations. 🥰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e7160665a65210e6cdcc6e8bb638baef925e3d4a.png

The main partner of Animal Week is WWF Poland, a leading conservation organization, that brings their extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability. Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

Read more about helping the TIGER 🐯 click the banner below 👇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0f02d1c40abac7b658288ca99db9557afc693ce7.png

Think globally act locally 🌍

Let’s make a difference together through the power of gaming! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♂️ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/91f3a34156d093b6bf3cf365dcaa294e9aff9a56.png

Have Fun!!
Games Incubator Team

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
Interaction with items is more flexible. There will no longer be a situation where an interaction failed notification is shown when trying to fill a bowl
 You can no longer interact with items through the wall
 Playing with the cat has been simplified a bit. Cat jumps on the feathers more slowly
 Fixed picking up newspapers lying on the floor. You don't have to destroy the floor to pick up the newspapers
 Improved employee interaction with the microwave. Employee should no longer get stuck when trying to interact with the microwave
 Animal needs don't increase so much with change of day

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug with textures that caused the performance to drop to 1 fps on some devices
- Made partial corrections to translations
- Reduced the size of the game on disk
- Customers first come to pick up pets and then hand them over so that swaping animals to the same room on the same day can be possible
- Added light volumetric mist
- Disabled next tutorial button in last tutorial

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
During free play, a tooltip on how to open the tablet is displayed all the time
 In buy walls, floor or roof mode with the camera from above enabled, you can change floors with the PageUp and PageDown keys
 Temporarily disabled step simulation on the camera, the camera will not move up and down
 You can place rooms on grass, but they will still require a floor to function
 Lamps saves that they are on or off and will remain so after loading the game
 Dog should no longer stop behind a wall when the player interacts with the tub faster than the dog on leash can reach the player
 A notification appears if the player tries to assign a function to a key that is already assigned to another function


Thank you very much to everyone for suggestions and reporting bugs, thanks to you the game can be better and better :)

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
This is just a small update that fixes the following issues:


 Employees will not spawn a million times after changing their working hours after they have finished their shift
 Fixed an issue where a wall could not be sold if there was an object hanging near it but not specifically on it

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
The cat will no longer teleport to the claw trimmer station after being placed in his room
 Drying with a dryer should no longer stutter
 You can close the door by clicking on the actual door
 Manager's desk and registration desks take up more space so that there is always room for employees and customers
 The show notes button on the pet registration computer is more noticeable

notes.title: Massaging the Hotel attenders😺
notes.content:
Hello Pets Hotel Owners! 🐶
Today we are gonna go over the massage service you will be able to provide for your favorite animals!🐢❤

Massage🥰
Masseuses need to be called in to their stations every time there is a job for them📞

Items used only by your workers will be marked accordingly in the shop🎀

If you have 10 pets and 6 of them have to be massaged you will need to call a specialist for the job to take care of the pets one by one.👩‍🏫

Everything to make your pets feel loved and cared for🥰

Special service💅🏻
When the client calls there is going to be a window that will appear, informing you about the details of an animal and displaying an additional service like a massage🙀 that the client may want to be performed.🤳

If the player bought equipment letting him do that service he can accept the pet.💲✅

For the special service you have to buy special equipment and set it up in its designated place.👨‍🏫

We hope you will have a lot of fun with these special services added to the game! Let us know what you think about it in our Discord! (link below) Don’t forget to wishlist the game to get the freshest devlogs delivered right under your doorstep!  ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43034904/ee382ff33504d56841598b8a69ea5770a101be7f.png


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714250/Pets_Hotel/

Massage you soon!
The Pets Hotel Team
